news.title: Arsenal 2-3 Borussia Dortmund: Arsenal lose to Borussia Dortmund as Odegaard returns
news.lede: Summer signing Christos Tzolis had a hand in both Arsenal goals. Arsenal returned to Emirates Stadium for the first time since they were crowned Premier League champions but were defeated 3-2 by Borussia Dortmund in the Emirates Cup. Samuele Inacio opened the scoring with a neat finish before Konstantino Karetsas curled in an excellent second. Substitute Ethan Nwaneri pulled one back for Arsenal after some good work from Christos Tzolis.

news.title: Gianni Infantino is 'destroying the very essence' of football after World Cup plan
news.lede: Gianni Infantino is the victim of a smear campaign to boot him out of football, according to FIFA. The sport’s world governing body has blasted a ‘concerted and ongoing effort’ to ‘undermine’ both it and its president. It comes after it was claimed UEFA had to pay off Infantino’s former lover when he worked for the European football association. Infantino, 56, who worked for UEFA for 16 years before being elected FIFA president in 2016, has vehemently denied the allegation.

news.title: England World Cup hero Jude Bellingham watches from stands as brother Jobe takes on Arsenal in pre-season battle
news.lede: ENGLAND superstar Jude Bellingham was spotted watching his brother Jobe Bellingham and former club Borussia Dortmund take on Arsenal. Dortmund defeated Arsenal 3-2 in a blockbuster pre-season friendly at the Emirates. And Jude, 23, made his presence known in the VIP section of the Gunners’ stadium keeping an eye on the action. The versatile midfielder got to see Jobe, 20, starting for BVB and playing the entirety of the game against the Premier League champions.

news.title: Infantino’s era is over, says La Liga boss as pressure mounts on Fifa
news.lede: Associations such as Uefa and the Football Association have called for Gianni Infantino to resign as Fifa president. (EPA Images pic) LONDON: La Liga president Javier Tebas claims Gianni Infantino is “destroying the very essence” of football and believes his time as Fifa president has come to an end, PA Media/dpa reported. Infantino has faced criticism following his failed plan to seek private investment in a company which would run Fifa’s competitions and sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors. Fifa then revealed it “will not proceed” with plans, and Infantino on Wednesday apologised to national associations over how the plan was developed.

news.title: Vilda: Morocco’s World Cup Qualification Is the Result of a Women’s Football Project
news.lede: Rabat - Morocco women’s national team coach Jorge Vilda has hailed the country’s long-term investment in women’s football after the Atlas Lionesses qualified for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup in Brazil. Morocco booked their place at the global tournament by reaching the semi-finals of the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON), following a 2-1 victory over South Africa on Saturday in Rabat. Speaking at the post-match press conference, Vilda said World Cup qualification had been one of the team’s main objectives from the beginning of the competition, describing the achievement as the result of the development project implemented by the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF). He stressed that the qualification was not the product of chance, but rather the outcome of sustained work and planning aimed at developing women’s football in Morocco.

news.title: Manchester City 3-1 Atletico Madrid: Marmoush double helps Enzo Maresca's side secure win
news.lede: Omar Marmoush played in all five of Egypt's matches in the World Cup, with his country losing to Argentina in the last 16. Omar Marmoush scored twice in a three-minute spell in the second half as Manchester City came from behind to beat Atletico Madrid in a friendly in Seoul, South Korea. The Spanish side took the lead just before half-time when City failed to properly clear Koke's corner and Morten Hjulmand set up 16-year-old Jorge Dominguez, who shot past goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma. But City equalised in the 57th minute.

news.title: Faith Chinzimu relishing Malawi’s rise
news.lede: Malawi have taken the TotalEnergies Women’s Africa Cup of Nations 2026 by storm. The Scorchers, who are competing at the continental stage for the very first time since the tournament was created in 1998, mean business. A historic feat in their opener saw them stun record 10-time winners and reigning champions Nigeria 3-2 and since then, it has been a roller coaster. With these three points, they continued to believe that anything is possible.
